crossRefs.note: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because…
Now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever…
Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey,’ as it is…
Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” The angel departed from her.

translations.web: Now, Yahweh, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.
translations.bsb: And now, O LORD, let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house be established forever. Do as You have promised,
translations.kjv: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
translations.asv: And now, O Jehovah, let the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, be established for ever, and do as thou hast spoken.
